notes.title: Development Update — What Lurks Ahead
notes.notes:
[p][b]Greetings !! [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Development Update[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone! Hope you're all doing great. We’ve got some exciting news to share today — a new update is just around the corner, and it’s packed with some chilling improvements![/p][p][b]Sanity System Incoming[/b]
We’re introducing a brand-new [b]Sanity System[/b] that dynamically affects your gameplay. The lower your sanity, the more intense and unpredictable the horror becomes. Watch your mind… or lose it.[/p][p][b]Horror Event Overhaul[/b]
We've updated several horror events to make them feel more immersive, terrifying, and reactive to your actions. Expect more tension, more surprises, and more reasons to stay on edge.[/p][p][b]Coming Very Soon[/b]
[/p][p]Thanks for your patience and support — the nightmare is just getting started.[/p]

notes.title: NEW Chapter is almost ready
notes.notes:
Greetings!!!

We’re not on vacation or anything like that — we’ve been working on the new chapter and making many improvements to the overall gameplay, along with fixes to the previous chapters.

In a few weeks, we’ll be ready to release Chapter 3. This chapter will bring another 2 to 3 hours of gameplay.

No additional content will be released during Early Access (except for fixes and gameplay changes) until the final release.

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GmFmdFEWMAABMRW?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes [v0.7.1c] — Day One
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings!![/b]

Here's the patch notes for version 0.7.1. It contains minor fixes that improve the general gameplay.

[list]
[*] Note Tips are now clearer. Candles remain the same, but it's much clearer what players should do with them.
[*] We made minor collision changes that were obstructing the player.
[*] We have added minor hints throughout the Prologue to make the experience a little more progressive.
[*] We fixed a bug where it was possible to bug the inventory, which could cause the item to be unavailable on load.
[*] Various minor changes.
[/list]

We acknowledge that some people get frustrated with the hollow puzzle ([b]Prologue[/b]). We hope the Note Tip clarification will help. We will keep reading your comments and feedback and we'll see what changes need to be made.

If you have suggestions or wish to report a bug, please check the Steam Community Discussions!

notes.title: Early Access Launched!!
notes.notes:
[b]The Early Access is now available for purchase!
[/b]

Please share your content, comments, and feedback using the hashtag '#Cult_Vein' on X/Twitter.

We delayed the game release because we encountered some bugs that could affect the player experience in the game, so we decided to delay the game by one day.

[b]Here's a rundown of what this patch fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some visual bugs.
[*] Made some minor changes in Chapter 1.
[*] Fixed a bug that unloaded Chapter 2.
[*] Fixed some collisions that could get the player stuck.
[*] Fixed a bug that opened the door in Chapter 1.
[*] Made some minor changes to the locations of key items.
[*] Fixed various other minor bugs.
[/list]

If you encounter other issues, be sure to report them through the Steam forum or X/Twitter using the hashtag "#Cult_Vein", and we'll fix them as soon as we can.
